texts.name: Silf
texts.biography: During an attack by wild bears in the magic forest, Silf was saved by a group of nomadic centaurs. Since then, he has held a deep admiration and a great friendship for this people.

specialty.name: Centaur
specialty.description: Increases the Speed of allied Centaurs, Cnetaur Captains, and Centaur Archers by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every level (rounded up).
